env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local
mkdir $WORK/bin

cd w
logos build ./...
logos build -o $WORK/bin/tup$GOEXE ./g/cmd
exec $WORK/bin/tup$GOEXE
stdout '^3 <nil>$'
stdout '^7 seven$'
stdout '^0 <nil>$'
stdout '^0 $'
logos run ./l/cmdt
stdout '^3 <nil>$'
stdout '^7 seven$'
cd ..

env GOWORK=off
cd w/l
logos eject -o bout
grep 'T_0 int' bout/p/p.go
grep 'T_1 error' bout/p/p.go
grep 'T_x int' bout/p/p.go
cd bout
go run ./cmdt
stdout '^3 <nil>$'
stdout '^7 seven$'
# SPEC 0.3: ejected output builds with upstream go1.27.2 from $UPROOT1272.
exists $UPROOT1272/bin/go
exec $UPROOT1272/bin/go version
stdout '^go version go1\.27\.2 '
exec env -u GOROOT $UPROOT1272/bin/go build ./...
go vet ./...
exec $GOROOT/bin/gofmt -l .
! stdout .
cd ..
cd ..

-- w/go.work --
go 1.27

use (
	./l
	./g
)

-- w/l/go.mod --
module example.com/l

go 1.27

-- w/l/p/p.lgo --
package p

func Pair() (int, error) { return 3, nil }

func Named() (x int, y string) { return 7, "seven" }

var V (int, error)

var Vn (x int, y string)

-- w/l/cmdt/main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"fmt"

	"example.com/l/p"
)

func main() {
	a, b := p.Pair()
	if b != nil {
		fmt.Println(b)
		return
	}
	fmt.Println(a, b)
	n := p.Named()
	fmt.Println(n.x, n.y)
}

-- w/g/go.mod --
module example.com/g

go 1.27

-- w/g/cmd/main.go --
package main

import (
	"fmt"

	"example.com/l/p"
)

func main() {
	a, b := p.Pair()
	fmt.Println(a, b)
	x, y := p.Named()
	fmt.Println(x, y)
	fmt.Println(p.V.T_0, p.V.T_1)
	fmt.Println(p.Vn.T_x, p.Vn.T_y)
}
